priorBehavior.allowlistSource: CORS_ORIGIN or ALLOWED_ORIGINS env (comma-separated exact origins); set on Render dashboard, not committed (no render.yaml)
priorBehavior.matching: exact-string allowlist.includes(origin); credentials + exact reflection on match
priorBehavior.credentialedRequestPolicy: credentials granted ONLY to explicitly allowed origins; never wildcard-with-credentials; never reflects arbitrary Origin
priorBehavior.gap: the ephemeral per-deployment Vercel Preview origin was not in the staging allowlist, so the browser blocked credentialed Preview->staging requests

previewAliasBehavior.teamSuffix: owner Vercel team slug is globally unique and owner-controlled; a third party cannot register it
previewAliasBehavior.protection: all Preview deployments are Vercel SSO-protected (non-production)

stagingVsProductionSeparation.detection: server-injected Render markers (RENDER_SERVICE_NAME contains 'staging' OR RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL host is the staging host); never the client Host header
stagingVsProductionSeparation.productionUnaffected: on production the staging gate is false; the exact env allowlist alone governs (unchanged)

credentialedRequestPolicyAfterFix: unchanged for production; on staging, the approved Preview origin additionally receives credentials + exact reflection; all other origins still fail closed
